title: Meeting the touring big bands in Tampa, Lunceford's gentlemen
summary: He met the bands' buses in Tampa and admired the sharp dress of Jimmie Lunceford's men versus other bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: And I moved on. And so that's when I--we really got to meet a lot of musicians. I met a lot of musicians in Tampa because when those big bands and things used to come to Tampa, I always met the bus in front of the hotel, you know. And the guys--them guys said "there he is again, waiting for us."

You know, they would always--but I was--I was fascinated about, Jimmie Lunceford's band. For some reason, they kept me--and every one of those guys was gentlemans, man. They would step off the bus like they just came from downtown somewhere. They all had suits on, you know.
Briefcases with their horns and stuff, man.
